entries.text: 我是派舒蕾・慕滋的店长阿枫～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_first_00

entries.text: 哎呀～说起来我是作为\n道馆馆主被叫来的～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_first_01

entries.text: 没想到能在这里遇到你，\n真是不可思议啊～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_01

entries.text: 是我叫你来的
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 真不可思议
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 哎呀～是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n叫我来的～？真让人高兴呀～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_02

entries.text:
哎呀～但你的表情
看上去很平静呀～\c
难道是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你
把我叫来的～！？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_02b

entries.text: 要是那样的话～\n就完全没有不可思议的地方了～\r\n呵呵呵……[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_03

entries.text: 既然我是被叫来当教员的，\n那可得认真一点才行～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_04

entries.text: 让我把虫宝可梦的魅力！\n传递给学园的各位吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_05

entries.text: 我前阵子在生态巨蛋\n悠哉悠哉地散步时～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_01

entries.text: 和可爱的虫宝可梦\n有了一场美妙的邂逅～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_02

entries.text: 它又小又可爱，\n还拥有电属性～\r\n你知道那宝可梦叫什么吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_03

entries.text: 电击怪
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 灯笼鱼
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 电电虫
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_03

entries.text:
哎呀呀～那大概
不是虫宝可梦～！\c
它还“电电”地叫了～！
或许它是“电电虫”～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04

entries.text: 应该就是那孩子～！\n因为它还“电电”地叫了～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04b

entries.text: 在帕底亚不会出现\n这种虫宝可梦呀～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_05

entries.text: 新的甜点要不就用电电虫\n做主题来创作吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_06

entries.text: 最近从生态巨蛋加入\n我同行队伍的宝可梦\r\n是谁呢～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_01

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_02

entries.text: 电蜘蛛
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 滴蛛霸
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 阿利多斯
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 哎呀～你答错了哦～\n稍微再想想吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03

entries.text: 叮咚！你答对了～！\n你观察我观察得很仔细嘛～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03b

entries.text: 滴蛛霸拥有水属性，\n会栖息在水边哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_04

entries.text: 你要不要在散步时\n顺便去找找它呢～！？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_05

entries.text: 托你的福，我遇到了新的虫宝可梦。\n真是让人乐呵呵～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_00

entries.text: 要不来和我进行宝可梦交换～\n培育更～多虫宝可梦吧～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_02

entries.text: 真让人开心呀～！\n我会给你三蜜蜂～\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你呢～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_03

entries.text: 是[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊～\n真可爱～谢谢～！\r\n我会好好地让它羽化的～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_04

entries.text: 你要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的三蜜蜂交换吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_03

entries.text:
哎呀～同行宝可梦只有１只的话，
是不能用来交换的哦～\c
等你有２只以上同行宝可梦后，
再来找我吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_00

entries.text: 等你想见虫宝可梦时\n再来找我吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_01

entries.text: 哎呀～你想来\n交换虫宝可梦了吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_04_00

entries.text: 哎呀哎呀～难道你想\n邀请我来对战吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_talkto_00

entries.text: 不是吗～？\n是我太武断了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_cancel_00

entries.text: 真期待能尝尝你的宝可梦\n羽化到什么滋味了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 哎呀～你果然厉害～\n我完全不是对手～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 你的宝可梦真的\n羽化得很棒～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 对战之后，\n来品尝一下这甜点怎样～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 祝你今后前进的道路\n也能充满甘甜与柔顺～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 为了赞扬你战胜虫宝可梦们的\n那份实力，给你～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 呵呵～\n下次再来比试吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 呵呵！使出全力打赢了你～！\n感觉真～好～！\r\n谢谢你和我比试～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
在生态巨蛋散步
真有趣～\c
到处都有我没见过的宝可梦，
能得到许～多做甜点的灵感！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
全靠派舒蕾・慕滋的
店员努力工作，
我才有机会外出～\c
可要好好珍视
肯支持自己的人啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
虫太晶化后，
那触角很可爱吧～？\c
要是所～有宝可梦都
太晶化成虫属性就好了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]食欲旺盛，
总是会饿扁肚子～！\c
它也会吃很多
我做的甜点～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 我给你的\n三蜜蜂是雌性的～\r\n所以能进化成蜂女王哦～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
我想起了首席
跟我说过的话～\c
她说[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你
把我选为
你最喜欢的道馆馆主了～\c
谢谢你那像甜点一样
甜美温柔的话～\c
下次让我烤些专属[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你一人的
杯子蛋糕吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_sp
